title: Motor Position Restriction Checker
description: Learners judge ten illustrative order lines (arrangement, rotation, discharge and motor position) as Allowed, Not allowed or Height check needed, using FanPedia's motor position restrictions for SWSI Arrangements 1, 3 and 3F and the Arrangement 9SS swingout pairing. Each verdict gets the reason, a highlighted rule-card row and a marked drive-side sketch; a summary sets each verdict beside the correct one.

learningObjectives: The learner will judge whether each proposed combination of arrangement, rotation, discharge and motor position can be ordered as written, using the FanPedia restriction rules.

accessibility.notes: Inline SVG sketch labelled by its text caption; verdicts and line changes announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs, solid/dashed feedback borders and dashed ✗ or ↕ motor boxes pair with colour; keys 1-3 pick a verdict, Enter submits or goes to the next line, R toggles the rule card; the layout stacks below 600 px.

rules: SWSI Arrangements 1, 3 and 3F: BHD forbids Z for CW and W for CCW; TAD forbids W for CW and Z for CCW (motor interferes with the outlet opening).
THD needs a height check for CW with W and CCW with Z (motor may not fit below the discharge; an Arrangement 1 pedestal can be lengthened).
Arrangement 9SS is built CW with (L) or CCW with (R) only.
assumptions: The drive-side sketch is schematic, not to scale; W and Z are drawn beside the housing, X and Y beyond them, as in the kit's motor-position drawing.
limitations: Covers only the restrictions FanPedia lists for SWSI Arrangements 1, 3 and 3F and the 9SS pairing; other arrangements, K mounts and conduit box rules are not judged.

sources: Source: FanPedia PDF pp. 162-163 (motor position restrictions, Arrangements 1, 3, 3F)

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Committed verdicts with reasoned feedback, a highlighted rule and a marked sketch after each line, then a side-by-side review
keyQuestions: Which position does BHD forbid for a CW fan, and which for a CCW fan?
When is THD a height check rather than a forbidden position?
Which pairings can an Arrangement 9SS fan be built in?
commonMisconceptions: A restriction on a position holds for both rotations.
The THD restriction forbids the position outright instead of calling for a height check.
Arrangement 9SS lets the buyer choose either side for the motor.
assessmentOpportunities: First-attempt score shown as 'Verdicts correct: n of 10'; mastery is 9 of 10 on the first attempt.
